title: Frequently Asked Questions
excerpt: Find answers to common questions about Kahana Browser.
content:
Frequently Asked Questions

General Questions

What is Kahana Browser?

Kahana Browser is an enterprise-grade web browser designed for security, productivity, and collaboration.

How do I get started?

Visit our Getting Started guide for step-by-step instructions.

Technical Questions

What are the system requirements?

Kahana Browser requires Windows 10/11, macOS 10.15+, or Linux (Ubuntu 20.04+).

How do I update the browser?

Updates are handled automatically through your enterprise deployment system.
